summary: Iteration 7: Vercel build-failure fix verified end-to-end. (1) STATIC CHECKS — /app/vercel.json buildCommand is exactly 'CI=false yarn build' (was 'yarn build' — this is the belt-and-suspenders fix so Vercel's CI=true environment stops promoting CRA ESLint warnings to errors). Confirmed eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps comments at the exact locations requested: Recharge.jsx L25 (before `}, []);` of the operators-loading useEffect at L20-26), Transactions.jsx L15 (above `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [status, service]);` at L16), Wallet.jsx L24 (above `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [user.role]);` at L25). Bonus: Recharge.jsx also has an eslint-disable at L30 for the second useEffect on `[service, operators]`. (2) BUILD REPRODUCTION — Ran `cd /app/frontend && CI=true yarn build` (the exact command Vercel executes internally). Exit code 0. Output: 'Compiled successfully. main.43a693e1.js 232.16 kB, main.39509219.css 11.13 kB. Done in 24.22s.' No ESLint errors, no warnings escalated. (3) BACKEND REGRESSION — All 5 endpoints tested against the external preview URL return 200: POST /api/auth/login (admin@rechargepro.com/Admin@12345), GET /api/operators (returned full operator map for mobile_prepaid/dth/electricity/data_card), GET /api/wallet/balance ({balance: 0.0}), GET /api/wallet/ledger ([]), GET /api/transactions?limit=3 (7 seeded rows returned). (4) FRONTEND UI REGRESSION via Playwright on desktop (1440x900) — Logged in as admin, hit /recharge (4 service tiles render, operator select populated with 'Airtel' for mobile_prepaid; switching to DTH re-populated to 'Tata Play' — confirming both useEffects still fire correctly after eslint-disable comment addition), hit /transactions (7 rows rendered, filter change to status='success' triggered reload via the modified useEffect), hit /wallet (balance '₹ 0.00' rendered, ledger section rendered, downline select populated). NO console errors, NO page errors, NO blank states. The eslint-disable comments are purely lint-suppression — runtime behavior is bit-for-bit identical, as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Suppression via eslint-disable-next-line is fine for this fix, but the more idiomatic React solution would be to wrap `load` in useCallback and add it to the dep array — worth doing when there is time. The current suppression is safe because `load` is defined inline in the component body and closes over stable setters + `user.role` (already in deps for Wallet).

Recharge.jsx L28-31 second useEffect: the eslint-disable there is technically unnecessary now — `service` and `operators` are both in the dep array, so react-hooks/exhaustive-deps would not warn. Not a bug, just dead-comment noise. Safe to remove but not required.

vercel.json buildCommand='CI=false yarn build' is correct and pragmatic. Long-term consideration: with CI=false, real ESLint errors on future PRs will also be silenced during deploy. Recommend also wiring a CI-side lint step (GH Actions or similar) that runs with CI=true so lint regressions still fail before merge, just not at Vercel deploy time.

Dev-mode console warning observed on /wallet: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — this is caused by an emergent VE dev instrumentation wrapping the {u.name}/{u.role}/{u.wallet_balance} template expressions in tracking <span>s inside the <option> at Wallet.jsx L66. NOT caused by this iteration's changes; pre-existing and only visible in dev-mode. In production build the wrappers are stripped and the warning disappears.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Vercel deploy blocker is RESOLVED. `CI=true yarn build` in /app/frontend now exits 0 with 'Compiled successfully.' This is the exact command Vercel runs. Do NOT re-introduce a `yarn build` (without CI=false) into /app/vercel.json — Vercel forces CI=true and CRA promotes warnings to errors under CI=true. The eslint-disable comments at Recharge.jsx:25, Recharge.jsx:30, Transactions.jsx:15, Wallet.jsx:24 must be preserved OR the surrounding useEffect deps must be fixed properly (useCallback + include `load` in deps). rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Vercel sets CI=true in its build environment. Create-React-App's build script promotes any ESLint warning to a build-breaking error when CI=true. The RechargePro frontend had three real react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings — Recharge.jsx:20-26 (operators-load useEffect with empty deps but reads `service` from closure), Transactions.jsx:16 (useEffect calls `load` but `load` is not in deps), Wallet.jsx:25 (same pattern — `load` not in deps). Locally these were harmless warnings, but on Vercel they crashed the build with exit code 1. REPRODUCTION: cd /app/frontend && CI=true yarn build → exit 1 before fix. FIX APPLIED (by main agent, verified by me): (a) added `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` immediately above the closing `}, [deps]);` of each offending useEffect, and (b) as a belt-and-suspenders safeguard, changed /app/vercel.json services.frontend.buildCommand from 'yarn build' to 'CI=false yarn build' so even a future lint regression won't break Vercel deploys. MITIGATION VERIFIED: `CI=true yarn build` now exits 0 with 'Compiled successfully.' + no lint output. All three modified pages (Recharge, Transactions, Wallet) verified functionally intact via live Playwright + curl regression.
